sensors.title: Electricity Optimizer
sensors.description: Choose the electricity price sensor. Fields with * are required. Fields marked "optional" may be left empty.

data_description.price_entity: Required. The sensor must have the attributes raw_today and raw_tomorrow with hourly prices, as EnergiDataService provides.

solar.title: Solar
solar.description: All fields here are optional: choose the sensors for your solar installation, or continue without. They can be changed later under Indstillinger on the Solceller tab or under Configure.

data.solar_power_entity: Solar production right now (W or kW) (optional)

data_description.solar_power_entity: Optional. Used for the solar surplus, the gauges and the power curve.
data_description.solar_energy_month_entity: Optional. E.g. a monthly utility meter.
data_description.solar_forecast_today_entity: Optional. E.g. from Solcast or Forecast.Solar.
data_description.solar_forecast_tomorrow_entity: Optional. E.g. from Solcast or Forecast.Solar.
data_description.solar_peak_kw: Optional. Used for the utilisation percentage.

error.not_energidataservice: The sensor has no raw_today attribute with hourly prices. Use an EnergiDataService price sensor.
